frames.pelvis: origin at MIDH; root_tx/root_tz/root_ry planar floating base
frames.HAT: origin at MIDH; axes equal model axes at reference trunk-upright posture
frames.bar: rigidly welded child of HAT at (-0.095, 0, 0.6), identity orientation
frames.hindfoot: origin at ankle joint center; +x anterior; sole plane z=-0.071565
frames.toe: child of forefoot at (0.13625, 0, 0.01); MTP hinge axis -y

actuator_topology.semantics: ctrl equals physical net joint moment in N*m (gear=1)
actuator_topology.limits: none frozen at RES-83 (DF-03/DF-04, RES-85 ownership)

collision_classes.mujoco_default_filtering: filterparent enabled; weld-aware parent filtering additionally disables (pelvis,bar), (shank,forefoot) and (hindfoot,toe) per side (adjacent through the locked-midfoot weld / rigid attachment); documented in COLLISION_MATRIX.json

provisional_numerical.contact.solref: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 compiler default applies. PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; final values owned by RES-84/RES-86 (CC-10).
provisional_numerical.contact.solimp: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 compiler default applies. PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; final values owned by RES-84/RES-86 (CC-11).
provisional_numerical.contact.margin: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 default 0.0. PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; exact clearance guard is RES-84 (CC-09/DF-02).
provisional_numerical.contact.gap: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 default 0.0. PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; declared by RES-84 (CC-09).
provisional_numerical.contact.torsional_friction: 0.0 placeholder (friction cone term off). PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; numeric value owned by RES-84 (CC-07).
provisional_numerical.contact.rolling_friction: 0.0 placeholder (box-like plantar contacts, CC-08 nominal). PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; numeric value owned by RES-84 (CC-08).
provisional_numerical.contact.penetration_tolerance: not frozen at V3; RES-84/RES-86 solution verification (CC-12).
provisional_numerical.solver.timestep: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 default 0.002 s. PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; timestep verification owned by RES-86 (DF-08).
provisional_numerical.solver.integrator: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 default 'Euler'. PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; solver verification owned by RES-86 (DF-08).
provisional_numerical.solver.solver: not set at V3; MuJoCo 3.8.0 defaults (Newton/dense). PROVISIONAL_NUMERICAL; owned by RES-86 (DF-08).
provisional_numerical.actuator.limits: no torque/rate/power limit frozen; gear=1 net-moment topology only. RES-85 authority (DF-03/DF-04).
provisional_numerical.friction.sliding: 0.9 is the RES-95 nominal (CC-06), not a final calibration; mandatory sensitivity sweep [0.5, 1.5] owned downstream.

pose_construction.ankle_rule: ankle = root_ry - hip + knee - foot_pitch (zero foot world pitch = flat)
pose_construction.toe_rule: mtp = foot_pitch keeps the toe patch flat during heel rise
pose_construction.root_tz_rule: translate root_tz so the lowest legal patch corner equals clearance
pose_construction.root_tx_rule: translate root_tx so the 99 kg system COM is over the active support centre
